title.narrative: Greening Uganda's Free Zones

description.narrative: Active

Building upon the work of the EU program (UG15) the focus will be on further developing and greening the industrial zones. The proposal from the Government is attached, however this will not all be feasible within the project budget so we are still negotiating with them and Denmark. However it has likely three elements: 1) passing and greening the FZ bill 2) development of masterplans/physical development plans for 2-4 FZs 3) continue support to Entebbe and Soroti as GGGI has started as part of UG15

To build the capacity of the Uganda Free Zones and Export Promotion Authority (UFZEPA) to develop and operationalize export Free Zones that meet global green trade standards. This objective supports Uganda’s broader goals of: Achieving inclusive and sustainable industrialization, Promoting climate-resilient infrastructure, Facilitating green investment and trade, Enhancing job creation through green and circular economy approaches. Specifically, the project aims to: To build the capacity of the Uganda Free Zones Authority (UFZA) to develop and operationalize export Free Zones that meet global green trade standards. This objective supports Uganda’s broader goals of: Achieving inclusive and sustainable industrialization, Promoting climate-resilient infrastructure, Facilitating green investment and trade, Enhancing job creation through green and circular economy approaches.
